notes.title: Update v1.6 - Wimp Mode
notes.notes:
Update v1.6 Changelog:


 ​New feature - "Wimp" mode, which can be accessed from the settings menu: now you can enjoy a challenge-free experience with zero enemies, allowing even the most blockheaded Players to beat the game!​​​
 Fixed major bug with end-game content.
 Increased spacing between buttons for touch controls.

notes.title: Update v1.5
notes.notes:
Update v1.5 Changelog


 Added ability to move using analog sticks on gamepad (also compatible with TATE mode).
 Some forest chunks have been moved to snow biome to better balance the starting area.
 Fixed some minor bugs with achievements.

notes.title: Update v1.4 - TATE Mode
notes.notes:
Update v1.4 Changelog


 New feature - TATE mode, which can be accessed by pressing "T" button in the settings menu. Press it multiple times for different screen orientations (clockwise, counter-clockwise or standard).
 Screenshake will not be applied to HUD elements anymore.

notes.title: Update v1.3
notes.notes:
Update v1.3 Changelog


 New feature - Instructions page which can be accessed from the title screen and contains detailed explanation of game's mechanics.
 More level variation in Forest biome.
 More level variation in Snow biome.
 A "pop-up" will now appear when picking-up keys, indicating that it is a key and not a chainsaw :)
 Game will now remember last fullscreen/windowed setting.

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.2.1 Changelog


 Hotfix for Muncher eating 5th poop breaking the game.

notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.notes:
Update v1.2 Changelog


 Added settings menu.
 SFX and Music can now be switched on/off separately.
 Option to switch between fullscreen/windowed mode.
 Option to turn touch controls on/off.
 Minor Forest level changes.
 Slightly bumped-up the rate and speed at which Muncher be munchin'.
 Buffed Straw Hat's starting equipment: 15 > 20 Sword, 8 > 15 Axe and 6 > 10 Hammer.

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.notes:
Update v1.1 Changelog


 Added option to pause/resume the game using ESC (keyboard) or START (gamepad).
 Fixed the issue with game scaling on certain resolutions.
 Increased chance for pots to drop equipment when playing as the Cat from 15% to 25%.
 Increased chance for toilets to drop poop when destroyed from 25% to 30%.
 Added pots and coins to starting chunks.
